# WC22 · Patient 360 · Bác sĩ (không có thu ngân)

Group **WC · Hồ sơ & Patient 360** · state · Next.js: **built (U3)** (`/patients/[id]`) · account `doctor-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/staff-context.js#apply`
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#patient360`
- Patient 360 is `clinic.js › patient360()`: hero, tab bar (`data-tab`), then one body per tab. `care-finance.js` injects the linked service/prescription panels under every tab except `crm` and `history`.
- `staff-context.js › apply()` for role doctor removes `[data-care-action="add-service"]`, `[data-care-nav="cashier"]`, `[data-ops="pay"]`, `[data-ops="quick-order"]` and `[data-quick-edit]` (billing capability); `PemaStaff.owns(p)` limits the patient list to the doctor's own patients (22 for BS. Tâm).
- Inventory note: Doctor projection: all eight tabs and the hero buttons stay; "＋ Thêm dịch vụ" and "Mở thu ngân →" (billing) are removed. Only the doctor's own patients are listed (22 for BS. Tâm).
- Page key `patient` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `doctor-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- Controls removed for roles without the capability: `careAction=add-prescription` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `modal=note` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `modal=edit` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `modal=care` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `tab=session` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor).
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"patients\"]"} → {"click":"tr[data-patient=\"P001\"]"} → {"wait":".patient-hero"}; it must show "Hồ sơ P001".

Kit components used: Card×12, Button×11, Badge×6, Tabs×1, EmptyState×1; shared pieces: Notice×4. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

## Business rules
- (old web notice) "MINH HỌA TỔNG HỢP"
- (old web notice) "Ảnh minh họa tổng hợp cho prototype. Ảnh lâm sàng thật cần gắn vùng chụp, tư thế, thời điểm và đồng ý sử dụng."
- (old web notice) "Chăm sóc và phục hồi sau buổi điều trị"
- Clinical actions need the `clinical` capability (owner, doctor); without it `action()` answers "Cần tài khoản bác sĩ để thực hiện." and `staff-context.js › apply()` removes the controls.
- The doctor keeps all eight tabs ("Tổng quan" … "Lịch sử"), "AI brief", "Nhắn tin", "Ghi buổi điều trị" and "＋ Tạo đơn nháp"; "＋ Thêm dịch vụ" and "Mở thu ngân →" are gone.

## Differences from the app design
- App F1 is a vertical list of cards with links to the tabs; the web keeps hero, tab bar and every panel on one wide page.
- (generated) Notice of the old web not found verbatim in F1: "MINH HỌA TỔNG HỢP"
- (generated) Notice of the old web not found verbatim in F1: "Ảnh minh họa tổng hợp cho prototype. Ảnh lâm sàng thật cần gắn vùng chụp, tư thế, thời điểm và đồng ý sử dụng."
- (generated) Notice of the old web not found verbatim in F1: "Chăm sóc và phục hồi sau buổi điều trị"

## Gotchas
- Opening a patient from the list is a row click (`tr[data-patient]`) or the "Mở →" button; the tab is kept in the module variable `tab`, so a re-render keeps it.
